submission.justification: Algorithm-L2 is recommended because it achieves the highest signal efficiency (95.8%) among all compliant algorithms while satisfying all hard requirements. It outperforms Algorithm-L1 by 4.6 percentage points in signal efficiency (95.8% vs 91.2%). Algorithm-L3, despite potentially having good performance characteristics, violates the latency budget by 1.8 μs (5.8 μs vs 4.0 μs maximum) and is therefore disqualified as it would exceed the front-end buffer capacity. The threshold of 28.45 GeV keeps the background rate at exactly the allocated 8 kHz while maximizing signal acceptance, and falls well within the required 20-60 GeV range. With a latency of 3.1 μs, Algorithm-L2 operates safely within the 4.0 μs budget, ensuring reliable trigger operation.
